name: Uruguay
famous_for: Punta del Este luxury coastal resort, Candombe drum rhythms, historic Colonia del Sacramento cobblestones, and world-class grass-fed beef.
tourists: Over 3.2M tourists annually; famous for Casapueblo cliff sculpture house, La Mano finger sculpture in Punta del Este, and Rambla of Montevideo.
must_know: Carrying a thermos under one arm and a mate gourd in hand while walking anywhere is an inseparable part of Uruguayan daily identity.
fun_fact: Uruguay hosted and won the very first FIFA World Cup in 1930 at the Estadio Centenario in Montevideo.
